name: Dynamic Fields for Elementor and SCF/ACF
author: Ankit Patel

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to dynamically manage Secure Custom Fields (SCF) or Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) inside Elementor Page Settings.
You can organize different field types without modifying theme files or writing custom code.

Features:
– Add custom SCF/ACF fields directly in Elementor Page Settings.
– Available SCF/ACF fields Display at Top (EASY to GET).
– Supports multiple field types (text, textarea, number, url, wysiwyg).
– User-friendly interface for managing fields dynamically.
– Enhances flexibility for developers and non-developers alike.

This plugin is perfect for developers, designers, and website owners looking for an easy way to integrate custom fields into Elementor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it
  2. Enter Fields and Manage Order and Display
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor Page Builder?

No, You cannot use without Elementor.

Does it work with all the themes?

Yes, It works with all the themes which follows the coding standards.

What field types are supported?

Text, textarea and number.

Can I use this with other custom field plugins?

Currently, the plugin supports SCF and ACF. Support for more custom field frameworks may be added in the future.

Does it work with other WordPress plugins?

Yes, It works with most of the plugins. If you face any issue feel free to contact us we’ll help you. and provide all posible solution.
